**Published online:**
September 3, 2026

**Geographic focus:**

**Temporal focus:**
T1. Historical report [YES] — Reports recent INR moves, reserve levels, and this week's inflows
T2. Forward-looking reporting short-term risks (next few weeks/months) [YES] — Fed rate hike odds, oil price trajectory, RBI forward book management, reserve projections
T3. Forward-looking reporting long-term risks (next quarters/years) [YES] — India BoP surplus outlook for the fiscal year

**Synopsis:**
The Indian rupee hit a two-month high driven by a $136.4B fundraising inflow, lifting FX reserves to a record $729.3B. This gives the RBI substantial firepower to defend the currency. Key headwinds include rising crude oil prices (Brent +7% on the week due to renewed US-Iran conflict) and a stronger dollar supported by hawkish Fed expectations (~67% probability of a September rate hike). The RBI's ballooning forward book ($137B, all-time high) may cap rupee upside as the central bank needs to unwind short USD positions.
